text: Planning is done. This is the first lesson where terraform apply actually runs against Snowflake, building exactly what the last two lessons planned.
LOAD_WH and TRANSFORM_WH go in first, sized exactly as planned -- no new decisions, just the plan typed in as real HCL.
PINEHURST_DB, its three schemas, and the LOADER_ROLE and ANALYST_ROLE grants follow the same pattern -- every resource traces back to a line in the Lesson 6 plan.
Terraform plan, review, apply -- then a check in Snowsight confirms it matches. The pipe, stream, and task stay out of this apply on purpose; they depend on the ADF and Blob work still ahead.
Next: turning this provisioned infrastructure into a live, auto-ingesting Snowpipe.
